title: Unit factorization in the abstract derived adjunction construction
statement:
Let $\mathcal C_1,\mathcal C_2,\mathcal D_1,\mathcal D_2$ be categories, $F:\mathcal C_1\to\mathcal C_2$ and $U:\mathcal C_2\to\mathcal C_1$ a specified adjoint pair with unit $\eta:1\to UF$. Let $Q_i:\mathcal C_i\to\mathcal D_i$ be localizations at classes $W_i$ [lem-weil-pbc-localization-universal-property], let $L:\mathcal D_1\to\mathcal D_2$ and $R:\mathcal D_2\to\mathcal D_1$ be functors, and fix natural transformations $\alpha:LQ_1\to Q_2F$ and $\beta:Q_1U\to RQ_2$. Assume $(RL,R\alpha)$ is a left derived pair of $RQ_2F$ along $Q_1$: for every functor $H:\mathcal D_1\to\mathcal D_1$ and transformation $t:HQ_1\to RQ_2F$, there exists a unique $v:H\to RL$ with $(R\alpha)\circ(vQ_1)=t$. Let $\eta^d:1\to RL$ be the derived-unit lift of $(\beta F)\circ Q_1\eta$ by this universal property, as used in the canonical derived adjunction construction. Then for every $M\in\mathcal C_1$,
$$R(\alpha_M)\circ\eta^d_{Q_1M}=\beta_{FM}\circ Q_1(\eta_M).$$
